  <text x="18" y="350" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Europe</text>
  <text x="18" y="385" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#050505">European leaders agree</text>
  <text x="18" y="417" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#050505">on a new cross-border</text>
  <text x="18" y="449" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#050505">support package</text>

  <text x="18" y="480" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">By Sarah Mitchell • Brussels</text>
  <text x="162" y="480" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">• Updated 12 min ago</text>
  <text x="18" y="506" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">4 min read</text>

  <g>
    <text x="18" y="542" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">
      <tspan x="18" dy="0">EU officials said the agreement would accelerate aid for households facing</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">higher energy bills and broader economic uncertainty. The package brings</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">together short-term relief, financing for local governments, and a new set</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">of targets designed to keep essential services running through winter.</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">Leaders from Germany, France, Spain, and the Netherlands backed the</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">framework after a late-night summit in Brussels. Officials described the</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">deal as a compromise that preserves national flexibility while creating a</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">shared response to rising prices and supply-chain pressure.</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">The plan also includes an oversight mechanism so member states can</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">report progress every two weeks, with a review scheduled before the end</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">of the month. Analysts said the move may ease market anxiety, though</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">they cautioned that implementation will determine whether it works.</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">A spokesman for the commission said the deal reflects “pragmatic unity”</tspan>
      <tspan x="18" dy="24">at a moment when voters are demanding faster action and clearer results.</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>
